messages.subject: error - time varying covariate
parts:
Hi All,
I'm incorporating a time-varying covariate for previous animal detection (GB_Occ1, etc.) at each sampling station. I created a new object 'GB2013capt'.

# identify columns as time varying covariates
GB2013capt <- read.csv("C:/Users/Annie/Documents/BBMP/SECR/secr/2013_GBcapt_01_noOPP.csv")
timevaryingcov(rubopp2013trap) <- list(GB2013capt=c("GB_Occ1","GB_Occ2","GB_Occ3",
                                                    "GB_Occ4","GB_Occ5","GB_Occ6",
                                                    "GB_Occ7","GB_Occ8"))
timevaryingcov(rubopp2013trap)
$GB2013capt
[1] "GB_Occ1" "GB_Occ2" "GB_Occ3" "GB_Occ4" "GB_Occ5" "GB_Occ6" "GB_Occ7" "GB_Occ8"

But when I try and use  this covariate in secr.fit I get an error saying 'GB2013capt' is not found. I can view the object in my env't frame so it clearly exists, but obviously I'm doing something wrong here.

fit.lambdaGB.2013fulloppmale <- secr.fit(totalCHmale$BBMP13, model = lambda0 ~ GB2013capt,
mask = rubmask2014male, trace = F,details = binom, detectfn = 'HHN')

## Error in secr.design.MS(capthist, model, timecov, sessioncov, groups,  :
##   covariate(s) GB2013capt not found

I've tried some alternate coding to bypass this issue, but those have led to other errors.

Does anyone see any reason why 'GB2013capt' is not being recognized?
Thanks

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: error - time varying covariate
parts:
Hi Annie
This possibly has something to do with using $ to select one session from a (presumably multi-session) totalCHmale - the result from totalCHmale$BBMP13 is not necessarily a full CH with all the attributes you would like. I suggest you check by extracting the single session first CH <- totalCHmale$BBMP13 (or better CH <- subset(totalCHmale, session = 1) if it is session 1 etc., and check that the traps attribute of CH has the timevaryingcov you want, before calling secr.fit on CH.
Just speculating...
Murray

I suspect it might have something to do with the fact that I've only identified timevaryingcov to my rub objects, not the opportunistic traps. I have tried bringing in the trap covariate data 2 ways - 1) appended to my trap file but it does not like blanks/NA for the opp. traps and won't read the file. 2) the way I"ve currently set it up, I've brought in a separate .csv with detector # and the time varying covs. I left the opp. traps off this file and it reads it fine.
